modelValue.en-US: Content of the input, for v-model.

modelModifiers.zh-CN: v-model 修饰符 trim、number 与 lazy，由 Vue 在使用对应修饰符时传入。lazy 时输入过程中不更新绑定值，原生 change（失焦或按 Enter）时才发出 update:modelValue；change 事件仍在每次输入时触发。
modelModifiers.en-US: The trim, number and lazy v-model modifiers, passed by Vue for the matching v-model modifier. With lazy, typing does not update the bound value; update:modelValue is emitted on the native change (blur or Enter). The change event still fires on every input.

defaultValue.en-US: Initial content when the input is uncontrolled.

size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small.

type.en-US: The type of the native input.

mode.zh-CN: 输入框模式，可选 password，显示密码显隐按钮。
mode.en-US: Input mode; password shows a button that reveals or hides the text.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the input has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

hideSuffix.zh-CN: 清除按钮显示时隐藏后缀，默认两者并列。
hideSuffix.en-US: Hides the suffix while the clear button is shown; by default the two sit side by side.

showClearIgnoreDisabled.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 DatePicker 使用：禁用时仍可清除。
showClearIgnoreDisabled.en-US: Internal property used by DatePicker: the clear button stays available while disabled.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不触发 change，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; change does not fire during a composition and fires once after it ends.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的聚焦。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should avoid scrolling the document to show the newly focused element, for focus inside the component.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载时自动获取焦点（使用 preventScroll），禁用时不聚焦。
autofocus.en-US: Focuses the input on mount, using preventScroll; a disabled input is not focused.

maxlength.zh-CN: 最大长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它计算长度并截断，否则使用原生属性。
maxlength.en-US: Maximum length. With getValueLength the length is measured and truncated by it; otherwise the native attribute applies.

minlength.zh-CN: 最小长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它换算，否则使用原生属性。
minlength.en-US: Minimum length. With getValueLength it is converted accordingly; otherwise the native attribute applies.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the input is empty.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error、warning；error 时输出 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning; error outputs aria-invalid.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 原生 input 元素的样式，数字需带单位。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the native input element; numbers need a unit.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 所在元素的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the element around the insetLabel slot, for aria-labelledby to point at.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 maxlength、minlength 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with maxlength and minlength.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 内容变化时触发，供 v-model 回写。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the content changes, for v-model to write back.

change.zh-CN: 内容变化时触发，参数为新值与事件；输入法模式下组合结束后触发一次。
change.en-US: Emitted when the content changes, with the new value and the event; in IME mode it fires once after the composition ends.

clear.en-US: Emitted when the clear button is activated.

focus.zh-CN: 焦点进入组件时触发；焦点在输入框与组件内按钮之间移动不触发。事件为外层元素的 focusin。
focus.en-US: Emitted when focus enters the component; moving focus between the input and its buttons does not fire it. The event is the focusin of the wrapper.

blur.zh-CN: 焦点离开组件时触发。事件为外层元素的 focusout。
blur.en-US: Emitted when focus leaves the component. The event is the focusout of the wrapper.

enterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时触发（keydown），输入法组合中的回车不触发。
enterPress.en-US: Emitted when Enter is pressed (keydown); the Enter that commits an IME composition does not fire it.

compositionstart.zh-CN: 输入法组合开始时触发。
compositionstart.en-US: Emitted when an IME composition starts.

compositionupdate.zh-CN: 输入法组合更新时触发。
compositionupdate.en-US: Emitted when an IME composition updates.

compositionend.zh-CN: 输入法组合结束时触发。
compositionend.en-US: Emitted when an IME composition ends.

prefix.zh-CN: 前缀。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
prefix.en-US: Prefix. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
suffix.en-US: Suffix. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

addonBefore.zh-CN: 前置标签。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
addonBefore.en-US: Addon before the input. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

addonAfter.zh-CN: 后置标签。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
addonAfter.en-US: Addon after the input. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button, effective when showClear is true.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦原生 input；未传 preventScroll 时使用同名属性的值。
focus.en-US: Focuses the native input; the preventScroll prop applies when the option is not given.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the input.

setSelectionRange.zh-CN: 设置选区，参数同原生 setSelectionRange。
setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native setSelectionRange.

input.zh-CN: 原生 input 元素，未渲染时为 null。
input.en-US: The native input element, or null while it is not rendered.

nativeElement.zh-CN: 组件根元素，未渲染时为 null。
nativeElement.en-US: The root element of the component, or null while it is not rendered.

modelValue.en-US: Content of the text area, for v-model.

modelModifiers.zh-CN: v-model 修饰符 trim、number 与 lazy，由 Vue 在使用对应修饰符时传入。lazy 时输入过程中不更新绑定值，原生 change（失焦）时才发出 update:modelValue；change 事件仍在每次输入时触发。
modelModifiers.en-US: The trim, number and lazy v-model modifiers, passed by Vue for the matching v-model modifier. With lazy, typing does not update the bound value; update:modelValue is emitted on the native change (blur). The change event still fires on every input.

defaultValue.en-US: Initial content when the text area is uncontrolled.

autosize.zh-CN: 高度是否随内容自适应，可传 `{ minRows, maxRows }` 限制行数。
autosize.en-US: Whether the height follows the content; pass `{ minRows, maxRows }` to limit the rows.

cols.en-US: Visible width in average character widths.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the text area is empty.

maxCount.zh-CN: 字数上限，设置后显示字数统计；超出时计数器标红，不截断输入。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of characters; setting it shows a counter, which turns red when exceeded. The input is not truncated.

showCounter.zh-CN: 是否显示字数统计；设置 maxCount 时总是显示。
showCounter.en-US: Whether to show the counter; it is always shown when maxCount is set.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the text area has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

disabled.en-US: Whether the text area is disabled.

readonly.en-US: Whether the text area is read-only.

autofocus.en-US: Focuses the text area on mount.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error、warning；error 时输出 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning; error outputs aria-invalid.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不触发 change，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; change does not fire during a composition and fires once after it ends.

disabledEnterStartNewLine.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 Chat 使用：Enter 不换行，Shift + Enter 换行。
disabledEnterStartNewLine.en-US: Internal property used by Chat: Enter does not start a new line, Shift + Enter does.

lineNumberClassName.en-US: Class name of the line number area.

lineNumberStyle.zh-CN: 行号区域的样式，数字需带单位。
lineNumberStyle.en-US: Style of the line number area; numbers need a unit.

textareaStyle.zh-CN: 内部 textarea 元素的样式，可设置高度等，数字需带单位。
textareaStyle.en-US: Style of the inner textarea element, such as its height; numbers need a unit.

resize.zh-CN: 是否允许拖拽调整尺寸及方向，可选 none、both、horizontal、vertical、block、inline；仅在显式传入时生效，autosize 开启时忽略。
resize.en-US: Whether and in which direction the user may resize: none, both, horizontal, vertical, block or inline. It only takes effect when given and is ignored with autosize.

maxlength.zh-CN: 最大长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它计算长度并截断，否则使用原生属性。
maxlength.en-US: Maximum length. With getValueLength the length is measured and truncated by it; otherwise the native attribute applies.

minlength.zh-CN: 最小长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它换算，否则使用原生属性。
minlength.en-US: Minimum length. With getValueLength it is converted accordingly; otherwise the native attribute applies.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 maxlength、minlength、maxCount 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with maxlength, minlength and maxCount.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 内容变化时触发，供 v-model 回写。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the content changes, for v-model to write back.

change.zh-CN: 内容变化时触发，参数为新值与事件；输入法模式下组合结束后触发一次。
change.en-US: Emitted when the content changes, with the new value and the event; in IME mode it fires once after the composition ends.

clear.en-US: Emitted when the clear button is activated.

focus.en-US: Emitted when focus enters the component.

blur.en-US: Emitted when focus leaves the component.

enterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时触发（keydown），输入法组合中的回车不触发。
enterPress.en-US: Emitted when Enter is pressed (keydown); the Enter that commits an IME composition does not fire it.

resize.zh-CN: 尺寸变化时触发：autosize 导致高度变化时参数为 border-box 高度；拖拽调整尺寸时为内容区的 height 与 width。
resize.en-US: Emitted when the size changes: with autosize the payload is the border-box height; when the user drags to resize it is the content-box height and width.

compositionstart.zh-CN: 输入法组合开始时触发。
compositionstart.en-US: Emitted when an IME composition starts.

compositionupdate.zh-CN: 输入法组合更新时触发。
compositionupdate.en-US: Emitted when an IME composition updates.

compositionend.zh-CN: 输入法组合结束时触发。
compositionend.en-US: Emitted when an IME composition ends.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the text area.

setSelectionRange.zh-CN: 设置选区，参数同原生 setSelectionRange。
setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native setSelectionRange.

textarea.zh-CN: 原生 textarea 元素，未渲染时为 null。
textarea.en-US: The native textarea element, or null while it is not rendered.

nativeElement.zh-CN: 组件根元素，未渲染时为 null。
nativeElement.en-US: The root element of the component, or null while it is not rendered.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 large、default、small，下发给每个子级。
size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small; passed to every child.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，下发给子级；子级自己写的 disabled 优先。
disabled.en-US: Whether the group is disabled, passed to the children; a disabled the child sets itself takes precedence.

label.zh-CN: 组的标签配置（Form.Label 的属性，另可设 id、class、style）；text、extra 只接受字符串或数字，节点内容使用 label、labelExtra 插槽。
label.en-US: Label configuration of the group (Form.Label props, plus id, class and style); text and extra accept only strings or numbers, use the label and labelExtra slots for nodes.

labelPosition.zh-CN: 标签位置，可选 top 或 left。

focus.zh-CN: 组内元素获得焦点时触发（focusin），焦点在子级之间移动也会触发；不下发给子级。
focus.en-US: Emitted when an element in the group gains focus (focusin), including when focus moves between children; it is not passed to the children.

blur.zh-CN: 组内元素失去焦点时触发（focusout），焦点在子级之间移动也会触发；不下发给子级。
blur.en-US: Emitted when an element in the group loses focus (focusout), including when focus moves between children; it is not passed to the children.

default.en-US: The input components in the group, such as Input, InputNumber, Select, AutoComplete, TreeSelect, Cascader and DatePicker.
